verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor documentation describing a lockout-recovery strategy (e.g., backup key enrollment guidance, what's recoverable vs. not). Community threads instead highlight the opposite experience — users must manually track and re-register every account per lost key with no central mechanism (yubikey-comm-7), and lost/compromised keys require full manual replacement across all enrolled services (yubikey-comm-2, yubikey-comm-6) — indicating this is an unaddressed gap rather than a documented workflow.
